title: Contact
html:
Spotted a mistake, have a Korean word you want explained, or want to ask about reusing an article? We would like to hear from you.

How to reach us: leave a comment on this page or under any post. Every comment is read by the editor before it appears. If your message is private, say so and it will not be published.

Corrections: we check every correction against the sources and update the article, noting the change at the bottom.

Photos: images come from Wikimedia Commons and are credited under each photo. If you are a photographer and want an image removed or credited differently, tell us and we will act on it right away.

We usually reply within two business days.
